reason: Conversation 1 opens with the same stop-using and don't-reset safety advice, then asks sensible questions about programme, RCD versus breaker, and water near the socket. It correctly links the hot 65C trips and the clean cold rinse to a likely heater element with insulation leakage, while saying only an insulation test can confirm it. It also covers repair-versus-replace and warranty sensibly and points the engineer at the heating circuit. Conversation 2 gives only the safety stop and a generic engineer referral, with no diagnosis, no questions and no explanation, so it is safe but much less useful.
